hints: Define prefix[i] as the sum of the first i values.
Build all prefixes once, then answer each query directly.
analogy: Store a running total at every position; a range is the difference between two totals.
example: For values 3,2,4, prefix through 3 is 9; sum of positions 2..3 is 9-3=6.
algorithm: Build a 64-bit prefix array with prefix[0]=0. For each one-based query [a,b], output prefix[b]-prefix[a-1].
correctness: All values before a cancel when subtracting the prefix before the range, leaving exactly a through b.
